geometry: 14 by 14 canvas with a translucent black rounded background and a symmetric, pale translucent triangle-wave stroke. The background alpha is approximately 166/255 over most pixels; the wave spans approximately x=2 to 12 and y=3 to 11.
limitations: The smooth vector stroke is crisper than the softly antialiased source at enlarged scale. The native and 8x renders were generated and the enlarged rendering was visually inspected.
